newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot gas softens ahead of holiday weekend.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot gas softens ahead of holiday weekend.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices drifted lower Friday as traders anticipated a drop in demand over the three-day weekend, market sources said.

Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was talked another three cents lower at C$1.59-1.60 per gigajoule (GJ), as temperatures in Calgary were forecast to slip to highs in the 60s Fahrenheit over the weekend.
June AECO was quoted at C$1.64, while one-year Alberta gas slipped to about C$1.73-1.74, market sources said.
Most offices in Canada will be closed Monday in observance of Victoria Day.
